retry_rule: Retry means identical intended effect, persisted key and payload bytes. A refusal records no effect or idempotency receipt. Edited input is a new intended effect, never an automatic retry. A mismatch must never be escaped by minting a key. Horizon-exceeded money writes reconcile before an explicit new intended effect. This catalogue does not implement retries, auth flows or service idempotency.
message_rule: ServiceProblemDetail type/title/status/detail are exact per-code constants. These protocol diagnostics are not UI copy. Fields are registered tokens; unknown input names map to request. Never copy provider text, inputs, amounts, balances, resource identifiers, account existence signals or stack traces. Structured Python validation diagnostics must exclude input.

codes.title: Capability unavailable
codes.detail: The requested capability is temporarily unavailable.
codes.precondition: Repeat only the same request inside the retry horizon; honour any server delay. A supplementary region can compose to degraded, but the code still binds to error.

codes.title: Access not available
codes.precondition: No automatic retry. If access is independently restored and the same intended effect is explicitly attempted within the horizon, retain its key and bytes.

codes.title: Access not available
codes.precondition: Absent, foreign, revoked and expired access is indistinguishable. Do not probe or retry a refusal.

codes.title: Request pending
codes.detail: The original request is still pending.
codes.precondition: Honour retry_after_seconds and Retry-After; same key and bytes only, inside P14D. This is not permission to execute twice.

codes.title: Request rejected
codes.detail: A valid request key is required.
codes.precondition: No effect. Restore a valid persisted key if one exists; otherwise durably allocate a random UUIDv4 before an explicit corrected first send. Never derive it from content.

codes.title: Request conflict
codes.detail: The request key cannot be used with this request.
codes.precondition: Mark failed and reconcile; never retry changed bytes or mint a key for the same bytes in response to the mismatch. The problem names only the caller's presented key.

codes.title: Mapping required
codes.detail: Review the column mapping before continuing.
codes.precondition: Corrected mapping produces a new immutable preview and a new intended effect/key; never mutate or recommit the old preview.

codes.title: Preview unavailable
codes.detail: Create a new preview before committing.
codes.precondition: Missing, unknown, foreign and expired uncommitted previews receive this same safe shape. Reconcile before explicitly making and committing a new preview; never silently import again.

codes.title: Allowance exhausted
codes.precondition: No retry unless the server stated a reset and it has elapsed; an absent reset or zero allowance permits none. Same persisted key/bytes and P14D still apply. A plan change is not an automatic retry trigger.

codes.title: Request limited
codes.precondition: Honour retry_after_seconds and Retry-After; repeat the identical request inside P14D. Do not substitute this shape for ADR-019's accepted-and-dropped recovery limiters.

codes.title: Request not completed
codes.detail: The request could not be completed.
codes.precondition: An unknown financial outcome is resolved by the same persisted key and payload, never a second intended effect; stop at P14D and reconcile.

codes.title: Request rejected
codes.detail: The request could not be read.
codes.precondition: No effect, including a known key with an unparsable body. Corrected bytes require an explicit edited request/new intended effect; no automatic retry.

codes.title: Access not available
codes.precondition: No probing or automatic retry; role changes do not authorise resubmission of an unknown financial outcome.

codes.title: Validation rejected
codes.precondition: No effect. Preserve the form; an explicit body edit is a new intended effect under a new key. Unknown/foreign Duplicate-Override is identical 400 validation_rejected, field duplicate_override, reason not_available. Correcting only that header retains the same persisted key/bytes under ADR-015 section 4.7; never automatically invent an override or mint a new key.

content_outcomes.retry: Not an error or an automatic retry trigger; the advice boundary remains in force.
